mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month year-over-year CPI change exceeds 3.0%, the market prices in aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12m yoy exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth above 0.5% and UNRATE decline below 4.0% signal a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST above 1500 thousand units), rising home construction activity directly fuels consumer spending and business investment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month trend in housing starts (HOUST) consistently signals near-term economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through rapid market reaction to new data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST shows positive month-over-month change.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.0%, the labor market is deemed sufficiently tight to support wage growth and consumer resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS cuts and PAYEMS growth above 0.3% signal coordinated policy support for economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as market confidence in policy effectiveness increases.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong labor market
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS decline > 0.25% and PAYEMS growth > 0.3% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply contraction regime (INDPRO below 100.0), declining industrial production signals reduced economic output and corporate capacity utilization, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as earnings forecasts are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0.
